name: Tetrahedral-Boundary Shelling Composition
definition: Take the common base $\Gamma$ to be the boundary of a tetrahedron and two pieces $\Delta_i=\Gamma*\langle\{a_i\},\{b_i\}\rangle$ with distinguished private vertex $a_i$ in each disjoint private block.
properties: Each piece has eight four-vertex facets and their assembly has twelve five-vertex facets. Its full shelling-record set is obtained by matching the two local base-facet orders and requiring disjoint active sets. Variants with a three-edge star base or three private vertices show that the theorem does not require ridge degree two.
